## Highlights
### Improved
- Show Start Page when entering a Mac Space with an unloaded tab, keeping the page unloaded until you select it
### Fixed
- Keep extension popup text readable and dismiss outdated popups when an extension reloads - Keep extension clipboard tools working when they initialize on pages that were already open - Avoid delays when extensions handle website messages through multiple listeners
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
